name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
applyChannel: the Beneficiary portal, Ayushman app, or an empanelled hospital / Common Service Centre
description: Health assurance scheme providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospital care to eligible poor and vulnerable families at empanelled public and private hospitals.
whoCanApply: Families identified as deprived under SECC 2011 criteria (rural) or listed occupational categories (urban), and families added by state governments. Eligibility is checked against the official beneficiary database.
benefits: Cashless hospitalisation cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year, including pre- and post-hospitalisation expenses, at empanelled hospitals across India.
estimatedBenefit: Up to ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year
occupationRequirement: Urban: specified occupational categories; Rural: SECC deprivation criteria
deadlineInfo: No deadline — enrolment is open throughout the year.

rules.label: Holds a BPL / priority household ration card (indicator)
No income-tax-paying member in the family (indicator)
Family listed in SECC 2011 / state-notified PM-JAY beneficiary database

documents.name: Aadhaar or other identity proof
documents.why: Identity is verified (e-KYC) before the Ayushman card is generated.

documents.name: Ration card
documents.why: Used to locate and verify your family in the beneficiary list.

process: Check whether your family is listed on the official Beneficiary portal or Ayushman app.
Complete e-KYC with identity proof.
Download your Ayushman card or collect it at a CSC / empanelled hospital.
Show the card at an empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

faqs.a: PM-JAY eligibility is based on SECC 2011 deprivation and occupational criteria, not a single income limit. Check the official portal.

faqs.q: Do I pay anything at the hospital?
faqs.a: Covered treatments at empanelled hospitals are cashless up to the family cover limit.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (PM-JAY for citizens aged 70+)
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
applyChannel: the Beneficiary portal or Ayushman app
description: Extension of PM-JAY to all senior citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of income.
whoCanApply: Any Indian citizen aged 70 years or above, regardless of socio-economic status.
benefits: Health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per year on a family basis for senior citizens aged 70+, with an additional top-up for those already in PM-JAY families.
estimatedBenefit: Up to ₹5 lakh health cover per year
deadlineInfo: No deadline — enrolment is open throughout the year.

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.why: Age eligibility is verified from Aadhaar during e-KYC.

documents.name: Mobile number
documents.why: Needed for OTP verification during enrolment.

process: Open the Ayushman app or Beneficiary portal.
Choose the 70+ enrolment option and complete Aadhaar e-KYC.
Download the Ayushman Vay Vandana card.

faqs.a: No. All citizens aged 70+ are covered irrespective of income.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
applyChannel: the National Scholarship Portal or your state scholarship portal
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship supporting SC students studying at post-matriculation (Class 11 onwards) level, covering fees and an academic allowance.
whoCanApply: SC students studying in Class 11 or above (including diploma, UG, PG) whose parents' annual income does not exceed ₹2.5 lakh.
benefits: Compulsory non-refundable fees paid to the institution and an annual academic allowance credited to the student.
estimatedBenefit: Full eligible fees + annual academic allowance
deadlineInfo: Applications usually open once a year (often mid-year to autumn). Check the portal for this year's dates.

rules.label: Parents' annual income up to ₹2.5 lakh

documents.name: Caste certificate
documents.why: Proves SC status, a mandatory condition.

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.why: Shows parental income is within ₹2.5 lakh.

documents.name: Fee receipt / bonafide certificate
documents.why: Confirms current enrolment and fees payable.

documents.name: Aadhaar-seeded bank account details
documents.why: Scholarship is paid by Direct Benefit Transfer.

process: Register on the official scholarship portal.
Fill the application and upload documents.
Your institution verifies the application.
District / state authorities verify and sanction.
Amount is credited to your bank account.

faqs.q: Can I get this with another scholarship?
faqs.a: Generally, a student cannot hold two scholarships for the same course. Check official guidelines.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
applyChannel: the National Scholarship Portal
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for students who scored above the 80th percentile in their Class 12 board and are pursuing regular higher education.
whoCanApply: Students above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in their Class 12 board, pursuing a regular degree course, with family income up to ₹4.5 lakh per year.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year at graduation level for the first three years and ₹20,000 per year at post-graduation level (as per scheme guidelines).
deadlineInfo: Applications open annually on NSP. Check the portal for this year's window.

rules.label: Pursuing a regular undergraduate or postgraduate course
Family income up to ₹4.5 lakh per year
Scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12 board results

documents.name: Class 12 mark sheet
documents.why: Merit (80th percentile) is checked against board results.

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.why: Proves family income is within ₹4.5 lakh.

documents.name: Bonafide / admission certificate
documents.why: Confirms enrolment in a regular course.

documents.name: Aadhaar-seeded bank account details
documents.why: Scholarship is paid by Direct Benefit Transfer.

process: Register on the National Scholarship Portal.
Apply under the Central Sector Scheme and upload documents.
Institution and state board verify the application.
Selected students receive payment by DBT.

faqs.q: Do I need to renew every year?
faqs.a: Yes, renewal depends on maintaining required attendance and marks as per guidelines.

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal – Post-Matric Scholarships
department: Government of Karnataka (Social Welfare, Backward Classes, Tribal & Minority Welfare Departments)
applyChannel: the Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP)
description: Single-window portal for Karnataka's post-matric scholarships and fee reimbursement for SC, ST, OBC and minority students studying in the state.
whoCanApply: Karnataka students from SC/ST/OBC/minority categories studying at post-matric level. Income limits differ by department and category (roughly ₹1 lakh to ₹3.5 lakh).
benefits: Fee reimbursement and/or maintenance allowance, depending on department and course.
deadlineInfo: Typically opens once a year. Check SSP for this academic year's window.

rules.label: Belongs to SC, ST, OBC or minority category
Family income within the department limit (varies by category)

documents.name: Caste & income certificate (RD number)
documents.why: SSP fetches caste and income details using the certificate's RD number.

documents.name: SATS / student ID
documents.why: Links your application with school/college records.

documents.name: Aadhaar-seeded bank account details
documents.why: Scholarship is paid by Direct Benefit Transfer.

process: Create a student account on SSP.
Enter your RD number and academic details.
Submit the post-matric application.
Your college verifies; the department sanctions and pays via DBT.

faqs.q: Why does SSP ask for an RD number?
faqs.a: It is the number on your Karnataka caste/income certificate, used to verify eligibility automatically.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
applyChannel: the PM-KISAN portal, a Common Service Centre or your state agriculture office
description: Income support to landholding farmer families, paid directly to bank accounts.
whoCanApply: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their name, excluding higher-income categories such as income-tax payers, government employees and certain professionals.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer.
deadlineInfo: No deadline — registration is open throughout the year.

rules.label: No family member paid income tax in the last assessment year
Not in excluded categories (serving/retired government officers, pensioners ≥ ₹10,000/month, registered professionals)

documents.name: Land ownership records
documents.why: Landholding is the core eligibility condition.

process: Register on the PM-KISAN portal (New Farmer Registration) or at a CSC.
State officials verify land records.
Complete e-KYC.
Instalments are credited after approval.

faqs.a: The scheme is for landholding families. Tenant farmers may be covered by other state schemes.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
applyChannel: the PMFBY portal, your bank, CSC or insurance company
description: Crop insurance protecting farmers against yield losses from natural calamities, pests and diseases.
whoCanApply: Farmers, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, growing notified crops in notified areas.
benefits: Insurance cover for crop loss with low farmer premiums: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
estimatedBenefit: Crop loss compensation at low premium
deadlineInfo: Enrolment closes on season-specific cut-off dates notified by each state.

rules.label: Is a farmer (owner, tenant or sharecropper)
Growing a notified crop in a notified area this season

documents.name: Land record or tenancy agreement
documents.why: Shows you cultivate the insured land.

documents.name: Sowing certificate
documents.why: Confirms the crop sown this season.

documents.name: Bank account details
documents.why: Claims are paid to your account.

process: Check your state's notified crops and cut-off dates.
Enrol through your bank, CSC or the PMFBY portal.
Pay the farmer share of premium.
Report crop loss promptly if it occurs.

faqs.q: Is it compulsory for loanee farmers?
faqs.a: Enrolment became voluntary for all farmers; loanee farmers may opt out as per guidelines.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0
department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
applyChannel: the PMAY-U portal or your Urban Local Body
description: Assistance for urban EWS, LIG and MIG families to construct, buy or rent a pucca house.
whoCanApply: Urban families from EWS (up to ₹3 lakh), LIG (₹3–6 lakh) or MIG (₹6–9 lakh) income groups who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
benefits: Central assistance through beneficiary-led construction, affordable housing partnership, rental housing or interest subsidy, depending on the vertical.
estimatedBenefit: Housing assistance / interest subsidy (varies by vertical)
deadlineInfo: Ongoing during the mission period. Check the portal for current status.

rules.label: Annual household income up to ₹9 lakh
Family does not own a pucca house anywhere in India
rules.doc: Self-declaration of not owning a pucca house

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.why: Identity verification for all family members.

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.why: Places you in the EWS/LIG/MIG category.

documents.name: Self-declaration of not owning a pucca house
Bank account details
documents.why: Assistance is released to your account.

process: Apply on the PMAY-U 2.0 portal or at your ULB.
Choose the relevant vertical.
ULB verifies eligibility.
Assistance is released in stages.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin
department: Ministry of Rural Development
applyChannel: your Gram Panchayat / Block office
description: Financial assistance for houseless rural households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses to build a pucca house.
whoCanApply: Rural households that are houseless or live in kutcha houses, identified through SECC 2011 / Awaas+ surveys and verified by the Gram Sabha.
benefits: ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult areas, plus support for toilet construction and MGNREGA labour days.
deadlineInfo: Based on the permanent wait list; no individual application deadline.

rules.label: Family does not own a pucca house
Listed in the Awaas+ / SECC 2011 permanent wait list and approved by the Gram Sabha

process: Check the permanent wait list at your Gram Panchayat.
Gram Sabha verifies.
House is sanctioned and instalments released as construction progresses.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
department: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
applyChannel: the PMUY portal or your nearest LPG distributor
description: Deposit-free LPG connections to adult women from poor households to promote clean cooking fuel.
whoCanApply: Adult women from poor households with no existing LPG connection in the household, belonging to listed categories (e.g., SC/ST, PMAY-G, AAY, forest dwellers) or declaring poverty under the 14-point declaration.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection with first refill and stove as per current scheme guidelines.
deadlineInfo: Open — subject to availability under the current phase.

rules.label: No LPG connection in the household
Holds a ration card (indicator of poor household)
Belongs to an eligible poor-household category or submits the 14-point declaration

process: Apply online on the PMUY portal or at an LPG distributor.
Complete KYC.
Connection is released after verification.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance
applyChannel: your bank branch, net banking, or the Jan Suraksha portal
description: Voluntary pension scheme that gives a guaranteed minimum monthly pension after age 60 based on your contributions.
whoCanApply: Indian citizens aged 18–40 with a savings bank account who are not (and have not been) income-tax payers.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60, depending on contribution; pension continues to spouse, then corpus to nominee.
deadlineInfo: No deadline — must join before turning 40.

rules.label: Has a savings bank / post office account

process: Visit your bank or use net banking.
Fill the APY registration form and choose pension amount.
Contributions are auto-debited until age 60.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
applyChannel: your bank branch or the Jan Suraksha portal
description: Low-cost one-year renewable life insurance for bank account holders.
whoCanApply: Savings bank / post office account holders aged 18–50 who give consent for auto-debit.
benefits: Life cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any reason, for an annual premium of ₹436.
deadlineInfo: Cover period runs June to May; can enrol any time (pro-rata premium).

rules.label: Has a savings bank / post office account

documents.name: Nominee details
documents.why: Claim is paid to the nominee.

process: Enrol via your bank, net banking or Jan Suraksha portal.
Give auto-debit consent.
Renew automatically each year.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
applyChannel: your bank branch or the Jan Suraksha portal
description: Low-cost accident insurance for bank account holders.
whoCanApply: Savings bank / post office account holders aged 18–70.
benefits: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability, for an annual premium of ₹20.
deadlineInfo: Cover period runs June to May; enrol any time.

rules.label: Has a savings bank / post office account

documents.name: Nominee details
documents.why: Claim is paid to the nominee.

process: Enrol via your bank, net banking or Jan Suraksha portal.
Give auto-debit consent.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (NSAP)
department: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
applyChannel: your Gram Panchayat / Taluk office or state social security portal
description: Monthly pension for elderly persons from Below Poverty Line households.
whoCanApply: Persons aged 60 and above belonging to BPL households.
benefits: Central assistance of ₹200 per month (age 60–79) and ₹500 per month (age 80+); most states add a top-up.
deadlineInfo: No deadline.
process: Apply at your Gram Panchayat, Taluk office or state portal.
Officials verify age and BPL status.
Pension is sanctioned and credited monthly.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (NSAP)
department: Ministry of Rural Development (National Social Assistance Programme)
applyChannel: your Gram Panchayat / Taluk office or state social security portal
description: Monthly pension for persons with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL households.
whoCanApply: Persons aged 18–79 with severe or multiple disabilities (80% or more) belonging to BPL households.
benefits: Central assistance of ₹300 per month, with state top-ups.
deadlineInfo: No deadline.
process: Apply at your Gram Panchayat, Taluk office or state portal.
Officials verify disability and BPL status.
Pension is credited monthly.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card
department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
applyChannel: the Swavlamban Card portal
description: A single national disability certificate and ID card used to access disability-related benefits across India.
whoCanApply: Any person with a disability seeking a disability certificate and UDID card.
benefits: Nationally valid disability certificate and ID card; simplifies access to pensions, aids, concessions and reservations.
deadlineInfo: No deadline.
process: Apply online on the Swavlamban Card portal.
Attend the medical assessment.
Download your e-certificate and receive the card.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
applyChannel: the PM SVANidhi portal, a CSC or your bank
description: Collateral-free working capital loans for urban street vendors, with interest subsidy and digital transaction incentives.
whoCanApply: Street vendors in urban areas holding a Certificate of Vending / ID from the Urban Local Body, or a Letter of Recommendation.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loans in increasing tranches on timely repayment, interest subsidy, and cashback for digital transactions.
deadlineInfo: Check the portal for the current scheme period.

rules.label: Holds a Certificate of Vending / ULB ID or Letter of Recommendation

documents.name: Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation
documents.why: Proves you are a recognised street vendor.

process: Apply on the PM SVANidhi portal or via a CSC.
ULB verifies vendor status.
Lender sanctions and disburses the loan.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
applyChannel: your Gram Panchayat
description: Legal guarantee of wage employment for rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
whoCanApply: Adult members of any rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per household per financial year at notified state wage rates.
estimatedBenefit: Up to 100 days of paid work per year
occupationRequirement: Willing to do unskilled manual work
deadlineInfo: Apply for a job card any time; demand work when needed.
process: Apply for a job card at your Gram Panchayat.
Submit a written demand for work.
Work must be provided within 15 days.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development
applyChannel: your Anganwadi centre or the PMMVY portal
description: Maternity benefit providing cash incentives to pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first child, and for a second child if it is a girl.
whoCanApply: Pregnant women and lactating mothers meeting PMMVY 2.0 criteria (e.g., SC/ST, BPL ration card, e-Shram registration, family income below ₹8 lakh, among others).
benefits: ₹5,000 for the first child (in instalments) and ₹6,000 for a second child if it is a girl, as per PMMVY 2.0.
deadlineInfo: Register during pregnancy; claims are linked to pregnancy milestones.

rules.label: Family income below ₹8 lakh (one of several qualifying criteria)

documents.name: Proof of eligibility category
documents.why: E.g., ration card, e-Shram card or income certificate.

process: Register at your Anganwadi centre or on the PMMVY portal.
Submit documents.
Instalments are paid after required check-ups.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance
applyChannel: a post office or authorised bank branch
description: Government-backed small savings scheme for the education and marriage expenses of a girl child.
whoCanApply: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below 10 years of age (up to two girls per family, with exceptions for twins).
benefits: Government-notified interest rate (revised quarterly) and tax benefits; deposits between ₹250 and ₹1.5 lakh per year.
deadlineInfo: Account must be opened before the girl turns 10.

rules.label: Parent/guardian of a girl child below 10 years

process: Visit a post office or authorised bank.
Fill the SSY account opening form.
Make the initial deposit.

faqs.q: Is there an online application link?
faqs.a: Accounts are opened at post offices and authorised banks. Official application link requires verification.

name: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
department: Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Karnataka
applyChannel: Seva Sindhu, Karnataka One / Grama One centres
description: Karnataka guarantee scheme providing monthly financial assistance to the woman head of the family.
whoCanApply: The woman recorded as head of the family on a Karnataka ration card (AAY/BPL/APL), where neither she nor her husband pays income tax or files GST returns.
benefits: ₹2,000 per month credited directly to the woman head of the family.
deadlineInfo: Ongoing — check Seva Sindhu for current registration status.

rules.label: Named as head of the family on a Karnataka ration card
Neither she nor her husband pays income tax / files GST returns

documents.name: Ration card
documents.why: Must list you as head of the family.

documents.name: Aadhaar-linked bank account
documents.why: Monthly amount is paid by DBT.

process: Register on Seva Sindhu or visit a Karnataka One / Grama One centre.
Submit ration card and Aadhaar details.
Monthly assistance starts after approval.
